summary: Step 7 (CLINE) DONE - Cline Worker Adapter. All seven approved corrections are implemented. (1) read/acknowledge are split: read_report(step_no, attempt) only reads and validates and NEVER moves, deletes or rewrites the file, while acknowledge_report(step_no, attempt) atomically moves the report into from_cline/archive/ and is only called by the caller after it has durably accepted the result. The old read->archive->return flow is gone, so a crash after reading no longer loses the report. (2) The attempt is part of the file identity: files are step_007_attempt_001_task.json / _context.json / _report.json, and the report JSON requires an integer attempt that must match, exactly like step_no; a wrong or stale attempt raises ReportMismatchError and is neither acknowledged nor archived. (3) Dispatch is ordered as commit marker: the context file is written first (temp + os.replace) and only then the task file (temp + os.replace last); if the context write fails the task is never published, so a worker can never observe a task without its context. A test asserts the exact write order and a separate test asserts that a failing context write leaves no task file. (4) WorkerPort.run() is a thin, honest convenience wrapper - dispatch + exactly one non-blocking read; it contains no polling loop, no sleep, no timeout scheduler and no acknowledgement (a source-guard test asserts there is no import time / time.sleep / while True / asyncio). I checked for a semantic contradiction with the WorkerPort contract and found none, so NO ARCHITECTURE_QUESTION was needed. The finer-grained dispatch()/read_report()/acknowledge_report() lifecycle is the public adapter API that the Step 8 orchestrator will drive. (5) Delivery is deliberately at-least-once: read_report keeps returning the same validated result until the caller acknowledges; after ACK the active report is gone and the archive holds an exact byte-for-byte copy; restart before ACK still sees the report, restart after ACK does not. (6) A corrupt, truncated, non-object, mis-shaped or mismatching report is never moved or deleted, produces an explicit adapter error (ReportParseError / ReportMismatchError) and stays on disk for inspection. (7) Everything else as approved. Boundary: every Cline-specific detail (protocol header, project/plan_version, directory layout, file naming, context_file) lives only in infrastructure/cline.py; WorkerResult lifts out only status/summary/artifacts(=files_created)/issues/architecture_questions and keeps the full report in raw exclusively - tests assert that protocol/project/plan_version/context_file never appear in WorkerResult and that the adapter module contains no sqlite3 and does not import application/architecture. Partial-JSON safety: writes are atomic (temp file in the destination directory + os.replace with fsync) and readers target only the exact final filename, so .tmp siblings are ignored. Verification: python -m pytest -q -> 852 passed, 0 failed (55 new tests). Architecture self-check still green: 27 modules, 0 violations, compliant; sqlite3 confined to infrastructure; no ports/application/domain/architecture module imports infrastructure. Scope respected: no orchestrator/scheduler (Step 8), no AI advisor/judge adapters, no UI.
